free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable to production: production access requires a paid subscription. A limited sandbox is available only to select users, generally through a free trial.

rate_limits.correction: Published but subscription-dependent: daily, per-minute, and per-second limits may apply. Paging requests with page_size over 100 and bulk requests are limited to 1/minute for free users and 1/second for paid users; free-data-only users have a 100 requests/second throttle.

cors.correction: Supported for public browser applications using an X-Authorization-Public-Key header and an allowlist of authorized domains.

notes: The API and example endpoint are current, and Bearer API-key authentication is officially supported. The entry fails because Intrinio publishes detailed, subscription-dependent limits and documents browser-domain public-key access, so rate_limits and cors should not be listed as unknown.
